remarks: COMING SOON. Located in one of Placentia’s most desirable neighborhoods, this four-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath home is offered by its original owner. The distinctive floor plan includes a downstairs primary bedroom and bath, vaulted ceilings, and a spacious, open layout. A large family room addition provides an inviting setting for entertaining, gathering with friends, or relaxing at home. Attractive landscaping and a three-car garage enhance the property’s curb appeal. The home is served by excellent schools, including Golden Elementary, Tuffree Middle School, and El Dorado High School, and is conveniently located near Tri-City Park, Whole Foods, restaurants, and entertainment
